diary.title: Парки Канады · Полевые записи
diary.passage: Sections 6.1–6.2 describe the field notebook, the daily journal and cross references to associated records.

drawing.title: Historic England · Руководство по полевой документации
drawing.passage: Modules 6–7 cover scale drawings, grid, north arrow, recording levels, establishing section datum and photographic references; module 3 covers recording samples and excavation method.

catalog.title: Парки Канады · Система полевой привязки
catalog.passage: Sections 4.4 and 4.6 give the lot number and object catalogue number, with association to optional three-dimensional coordinates.

volume.title: Кадисский университет · Расчёт вместимости древних сосудов
volume.passage: The article proposes estimating ceramic capacity from vessel profiles and comparing vessels to historic measures.

pottery.title: Ашмолеанский музей · Измерение вместимости сосудов
pottery.passage: Illustrates estimation by sand filling and relationships between capacity and rim measurements.

czech.title: Технологическое агентство Чехии · Аттическая керамика в Богемии
czech.passage: Research result on Chržín and Pilsen-Roudná Attic-style red-figure kylikes. Compared chemical and mineralogical composition with fine local Braubach ware and inferred probable local origin.

met.title: Метрополитен-музей · Изготовление аттических ваз
met.passage: Describes painting methods, clay coatings, firing in three stages and assembly.

erimi.title: Cahiers du Centre d’Études Chypriotes · Оставленные предметы Эримы
erimi.passage: Paragraph 14 identifies a quern and broken pithos as primary refuse; notes 22–23 distinguish discard at place of use and removal elsewhere; paragraph 5 notes quern reused in a wall.

fen.title: Oxford Archaeology · Раскопки в Фенленде
fen.passage: Appendix D.2.17–18 identifies residual earlier ceramic finds in topsoil, with manure suggested as a possible cause. Table of pottery sorts finds by context, pottery code, count and date.

oscill.title: Geological Magazine · Отложения грота Оскурушутто
oscill.passage: Sections 2, 5b and 5c discuss burrows, the disappearance of original lamination, traces of modern rodents/plants and aeolian sediment.

river.title: Служба национальных парков США · Раскопки у реки Колорадо
river.passage: At Ivo’s site near the Unkar Delta, surface erosion and gullying destroyed a slab-lined cist and exposed part of a wall; excavators documented stabilisation and backfilled. Axehandle Alcove contains flood silts alternating with coarser debris and preserved hearths.

stamp.title: Служба национальных парков США · Керамика тимукуа
stamp.passage: Discusses stamped, incised and other surface treatments; stamped pattern produced by pressing a carved paddle into clay.

note: Первый ремонт: варианты и заметки больше не повторяют определения соседних карточек. Для 086 отдельно проверяется 098. Для 089/090 взяты случаи из отчётов вместо общего сценария.
